messages:
maya: Heads up — provisioning for a batch of new GPU nodes in ap-northeast-1 is failing on bootstrap. Started ~10:03 UTC. Example error: `Error fetching bootstrap.sh from s3://redwood-infra/bootstrap/ap-nrt/gpu-ami-2026.sh: AccessDenied`.
ops-bot: autoscaler launched 5 instances, 3 failed to pass health check (bootstrap error).
sam: cc @maya any recent ACL/role changes for the instance profile?
maya: We rotated a KMS key and tightened the S3 bucket policy this morning (security request). Might have tightened the role used by AMIs to GET objects.
leo: Can you paste the instance role ARN and the s3 policy error from syslog?
maya: syslog extract: `curl -s -S https://s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-infra/bootstrap/ap-nrt/gpu-ami-2026.sh -o /tmp/bootstrap.sh` -> `403 AccessDenied - KMS key not found for encryption`.
anya: This sounds like the new KMS key alias doesn't include decrypt permissions for the EC2 instance role. Security changed key policy to require explicit principal.
sam: If it's KMS, the objects might be SSE-KMS encrypted. EC2 role needs kms:Decrypt on that key.
security-bot: KMS rotation event: key alias `alias/redwood-bootstrap` rotated by @security at 09:52 UTC. Old key scheduled to be disabled in 7d.
maya: We have hundreds of queued jobs; autoscaler keeps creating instances that never boot. Cost ramping up since AWS keeps billing for partial minutes for on-demand fallbacks.
leo: Short-term mitigation: revert S3 objects to SSE-S3 (no KMS) or add the EC2 instance role to new key policy. Which is faster?
anya: Adding role to key policy is quick but needs approval from security ops. Reverting to SSE-S3 requires re-uploading artifacts and might break auditing.
sam: Security ops — can we get an exception for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-bake-instance-role` to kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood-bootstrap for next 24h?
security: on it. Opening a temporary exception ticket. Will also push an automated key policy patch once approved.
maya: Also found bootstrap uses `aws s3 cp` which falls back to sigv2 for some regions; ensure SDK uses sigv4. Not likely root cause but worth patching.
ops-bot: Cost alert: provisioning failure caused 12 failed instances in last hour, est $150 extra. :cry:
sam: Once key policy is patched, we'll force a fleet bounce: `for id in $(aws ec2 describe-instances --filters \"Name=tag:role,Values=gpu-batch\" --query \"Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId\" --output text); do aws ec2 reboot-instances --instance-ids $id; done`.
maya: Can security confirm when the policy change will be applied? Need to stop autoscaler or else we'll keep burning.
security: Policy patch scheduled in 18m. We'll also add an allow for the build bucket to the new key. We'll post the policy diff here.
maya: Thanks. Stopping autoscaler now. I'll re-run a single test pipeline after patch.
leo: After fix, add an integration test that validates KMS decrypt for new keys during bootstrap.
maya: Agreed. Also tagging this incident for postmortem: `infra-2026-03-kms-bootstrap-fail`.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-1123.
security: Patch applied. Key policy diff:
```
+ "Statement": [{ "Sid": "AllowBootstrapRole", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-bake-instance-role"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*" }]
```
maya: Test passed. 1 test instance booted and completed bootstrap.
sam: Re-enabling autoscaler slowly.
ops-bot: Autoscaler re-enabled. Monitoring for errors.
maya: Postmortem items: document KMS rotation runbook, add automated role-to-key reconcile job, add pre-rotation integration test.
anya: Also check CloudTrail encryption: rotating key may have left logs unreadable in the short window — file a compliance note.
security: Will include CloudTrail check in the postmortem. We'll schedule key rotation blackout windows for critical infra.
maya: Thanks everyone. Closing thread once postmortem doc created.
